title: Parker Hit 430,000 MPH Without A Human Aboard
hook: Parker reached 430,000 MPH where no person could survive.
closing: Our fastest machine reveals the places human bodies still cannot go.
question: Where should Parker's speed take us?

segments.say: Parker reached 430,000 MPH in 2024 after climbing through every recorded pass.
Parker travels 17 times faster than the 24,791 MPH human record.
At Parker's speed, New York to Tokyo takes 56 seconds in scale.
